title: Features : Split bolus over time
body:
It would be great if we can split bolus over time. 

Usecase :
- In bolus wizard enter the amount of cards. 
- click on "split bolus".
- open new pop-up 
- select duration, split over x minutes 
- bolus from wizard is displayed. Click on it to split it in 2 parts. We could see percentage of each part. 
- can click on other parts to split again. 

This can be useful if you eat pizza and want to receive insulin in future. 

I also feel pain when bolusing more than 5 units, if I can split all my meals bolus over 30 minutes, it will be more confortable and convenient.

comments.body: If you would want to receive additional insuline as bolus or tbr in future for slow carbs or high fat content you would use eCarbs

But eCarbs only schedule carbs. I cannot schedule bolus...

I must to think to enter bolus later.

SMB is designed to do this automaticaly
Do a smaller bolus with food and let SMB do the rest 
Use ecarbs for for high fat foods
you can set % of given upfront bolus in preferences
I think that yrioux simply wanted the option to give an extended bolus that was unrelated to carb entries.
extended bolus goes directly against SMB alg. thus is not possible to use it
